description_en: Queries the certificates associated with a listener
description_zh: 调用ListListenerCertificates接口查询监听绑定的证书列表
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-listener-certificates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListListenerCertificates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

default
additional

If you do not specify this parameter, default and additional certificates are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
证书的角色。取值：
default：默认证书。
additional：扩展证书。

不传入值时，默认证书和扩展证书都将返回在证书列表中
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
本次读取的最大数据记录数量。
取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

Domain.description_en:
The domain name associated with the additional certificate.

This parameter is not returned if the certificate is a default one
Domain.description_zh:
扩展证书绑定的域名。

默认证书不返回该字段

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is a default one.

true
false
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认证书。
true：默认证书。
false：扩展证书

State.description_en:
The status of the certificate.

active: The certificate is associated with a listener and in effect.
updating: The additional certificate is being replaced
State.description_zh:
证书的状态。
active：证书绑定监听并生效。
updating：扩展证书替换中

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.
If a value of NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
